soundness_flags.label: ass:reference-risk-positivity
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited standard positivity condition is observed-risk positivity, whereas requiring rho_21(x,omega)>=epsilon for every compatible latent x is a stronger fiber-wide restriction; retag it novel and justify/test it by a minimum-risk LP, or develop the zero-denominator branch.

soundness_flags.label: thm:pooled-sign-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem calls Psi<1 or Psi>1 waning/strengthening of the challenge effect, but no positive placebo reference risk is assumed; either require the common placebo risk to be positive or state the result only as a vaccine challenge-risk-ratio sign.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:uniform-whole-set-projection
soundness_flags.one_line: “Exposure cells whose probabilities approach zero at admissible rates” leaves the uniform triangular-array domain undefined; specify the rate class or state an exact multinomial-inversion route that covers zero cells.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association, 2025 journal version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 point-identifies the interval-1 challenge effect and gives sharp interval-2 bounds under positivity of observed event risks; it does not state fiber-wide positivity over every compatible latent law.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and Section 2.1, “Surveillance anchored sieve analysis”
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper combines trial and community surveillance strain proportions, requiring surveillance strain distributions to reflect those for the placebo group and discussing sensitivity to misspecification.
The paper analyzes temporal behavior of variant-specific and relative VE measures under multiple competing variants and leaky/all-or-none mechanisms.
The article exists as cited and develops sieve analysis using numbers of infecting pathogens under an observed-process modeling framework.
The paper studies inference on vaccine protection varying with genotypic and phenotypic variation by comparing isolates from infected vaccinated and unvaccinated subjects.

The paper establishes causal conditions for nonparametric identification of relative conditional strain efficacy in observational case-only data and gives semiparametric estimators under a parametric relative-efficacy form.
The paper provides computationally feasible inference methods for a broad class of partially identified econometric models.
The calibrated-projection procedure obtains extrema by optimizing a target over relaxed studentized moment constraints and controls asymptotic coverage uniformly over a large class of DGPs.
The paper shows ordinary bootstrap consistency can fail for directionally differentiable maps and proposes an alternative resampling procedure with local size control.
The article develops a formal individual-level treatment-effect-constancy test, summary-data implementations, and additional waning bounds.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag fiber-wide reference-risk positivity as a novel, LP-checkable restriction and add the alternative extended-value/zero-denominator identified-set formulation so the target does not depend on an unacknowledged strengthening of ordinary observed-risk positivity.

State the pooled result first as a theorem about the named vaccine challenge-risk ratio Psi_omega; add positive common placebo reference risk only for the corollary translating that ratio into biological VE waning versus strengthening.

Specify a triangular-array cell-probability class for whole-set inference (or use exact simultaneous multinomial inversion), then prove how its rate condition controls changing feasible fibers and tied LP faces.

Add a worked K=2 numerical instance with an explicit compatible full-law lift and a dual certificate for the case-margin or mixture-radius question; this would distinguish the substantive common-history contribution from routine response-type and linear-fractional programming steps.

recommended_next_step: Revise the three soundness defects, then advance the field-tier common-history partial-ID kernel and retain the case-margin, sign-radius, and whole-set questions as the genuinely nonroutine targets.
